At nunu.ai , we've developed multimodal AI agents that revolutionize the way game studios approach these challenges. Our AI agents are designed to automate and enhance various aspects of game development, starting with quality assurance.

citations.title: nunu.ai — venture-backed company profile | Dealroom
excerpts:
About nunu.ai
nunu.ai is a company that has developed a platform for automated game quality assurance (QA) using artificial intelligence agents. These agents are designed to simulate human-like player interactions, performing end-to-end testing by analyzing visual information from the game.
The system provides real-time monitoring of test outcomes through dashboards with detailed reports and insights.
The company's technology is multimodal, meaning the AI agents can understand and interact with games in a way that is similar to humans. This allows them to identify bugs, assess game performance, and provide feedback to developers.
The business model appears to be a subscription-based service, with different pricing tiers available. The company is also focused on data security, pursuing SOC2 Type 2 compliance and offering features like SAML-based single sign-on for enterprise clients.
